findings.observation: Translation parameter mismatch was found in review when calling AppI18n::_().
findings.hypothesis: A static PHPStan rule can detect the recurring placeholder mismatch.
findings.validated_conclusion: Translation parameters can be checked statically by comparing format specifiers against argument count.

findings.observation: A second translation placeholder mismatch was discovered in order processing notifications.
findings.hypothesis: A static PHPStan rule can detect repeated occurrences across controllers and services.
findings.validated_conclusion: Both cases violate the same translation placeholder invariant and are statically detectable.
